fix.item: Fixed clean-site package installation failures caused by incomplete database schema created before install SQL
Fixed installer postflight fatal errors when StorageProtectionHelper and CategoryMenuService were not available during first boot
Fixed missing database index detection for idx_folder_batch_id on fresh installations
Fixed installer document index creation to use Joomla getTableKeys() API
Improved installer stability across clean-site install and update paths

change.item: Installer preflight on fresh install now defers documents table creation to manifest install SQL
Installer ensureSchema CREATE TABLE aligned with install.mysql.utf8.sql for update migrations
Production hardening retained: centralized MIME validation, HTTP Range for local files and listing indexes

note.item: Recommended first public release for new DevArt Documents installations
Install or update using the full pkg_devartdocuments package only
Safe update from alpha development builds and from version 1.0.0 package installs
No breaking changes to existing document records, categories or storage paths
Validated on clean Joomla 6 site install and on existing site update

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Documents component with modern MVC and service provider architecture
Added frontend DevArt Documents module and content plugin integration
Added editor button plugin for article document insertion
Added system plugin for administrator branding and integration hooks
Added filesystem plugin for Media Manager document storage adapter
Added task plugin for scheduled search indexing and folder scan profile imports
Added document library with categories, tags, publish windows and ordering
Added Joomla native category integration through com_categories
Added Joomla native tag integration through com_tags for com_devartdocuments.document
Added ACL with access levels, user groups, inheritance and per-document open/download permissions
Added local document storage with protected storage root and centralized StorageProtectionHelper
Added Google Drive storage integration with per-category folder configuration
Added streaming and chunked Google Drive upload, serve and search indexing paths
Added full-text document search on the category menu item page
Added optional external MariaDB search index backend
Added search CAPTCHA, rate limits and scheduled indexing support
Added folder scan profiles for batch imports from disk
Added metadata backup export and import through Tools
Added shared DevArt document card renderer for component, module and content plugin
Added display themes including red, orange, blue, green, yellow, gray and dark
Added category menu scope stored in menu params with clean canonical URLs
Added Tools area for Settings, Search index, Folder scan profiles and Metadata backup
Added dashboard statistics and storage security status
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support

change.item: Document architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+
Frontend listing uses DocumentListingQuery, SQL ACL filters and shared document card rendering
Routing and display behavior configured in Tools instead of generic Joomla component options
Local file serving supports HTTP 206 Partial Content through HttpByteRange
Upload, serve and Media Manager MIME handling centralized in DocumentMimeMap
Google Drive OAuth tokens protected through encrypted token vault storage
Category, module and content plugin listings share DocumentContentScope and DisplaySettingsResolver
Search index backend configurable for local component tables or separate MariaDB database
Folder scan profiles replace legacy global folder-scan settings for safer production workflows

security.item: Added controller to service to storage access flow without exposing filesystem paths
Added MIME validation for upload, serve and filesystem adapter operations
Added protected local storage root with deny rules and directory hardening
Added ACL enforcement for administrator operations and frontend document access
Added CSRF protection for administrator actions
Added encrypted OAuth token storage for Google Drive integrations
Added search CAPTCHA and rate limiting controls for public search endpoints

note.item: Initial public DevArt Documents release for Joomla 6
Install using the full pkg_devartdocuments package, not the component ZIP alone
Google Drive open and download does not support HTTP Range; local files only
Nginx and LiteSpeed require explicit server deny rules for the storage path
Image-only PDFs may be skipped by the search indexer until OCR support exists
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment
